headline: TRD Associates advises Ravin Infraproject on acquiring majority control in Ravin Cables from JV partner Prysmian

detail: Ravin Infraproject Private Limited has acquired Prysmian Cavi e Sistemi S.r.l.’s majority stake in Ravin Cables Limited, bringing end to an era of disputes between the JV Partners and restoring majority control to the Ravin Group by marking the complete exit of the Italian JV Partner. TRD Associates advised Ravin Infraproject, Vijay Karia (Chairman and Managing Director) and other shareholders on the transaction, providing end-to-end legal assistance, including advising on the strategy, transaction structuring, negotiation, drafting, reviewing, as well as the resolution of longstanding disputes.
